t.description: A looped trail descends the slope of the esker complex into a cedar bog crossed using a boardwalk. Access from Cedar Bog parking lot or from roadside parking near the West Gate. Alternate route avoids the bog. Pedestrians only.
A looped trail to the site of a lime kiln, used until the 1930s. Limestone gravel quarried nearby was burned there to make quicklime. A warming shelter is near the kiln site.
